findings.summary: When reviewerSet: staged is configured on the base ref, enforceReviewScope in verify-core.mjs calls checkReviewerKindCoverage, which requires correctness-reviewer, or code-reviewer plus test-reviewer. staged-review is in none of CORRECTNESS_NAMES, CODE_NAMES or TEST_NAMES, so every staged run's v6 envelope is rejected as 'reviewer set incomplete'. AC4 ('an envelope with these leaves verifies') is not met end to end. DEC-0094 (verifier-accepts-staged) names the fix; the diff does not implement it (review-scope-core.mjs unchanged, no verifier test for a staged leaf set, no negative test). Either add the verifier change with both tests, or apply staged-inert-until-follow-up so selection refuses staged until the verifier lands.

findings.summary: persistStageTranscript writes the planner transcript to the worktree before the execute phase runs probes (e.g. pnpm test) that execute PR code. Impact limited (plan/execute leaves carry no verdict; trusted backlog work only). Fix: emit the plan leaf or record the transcript hash before execute runs.

findings.summary: With reviewerSet staged, prepareReview spawns only the staged pipeline plus security-reviewer and never code/test/correctness reviewers. After DEC-0149 reverted expandStagedCoverage, enforceReviewScope still requires correctness (or code+test) coverage, so a staged run cannot produce a verifiable attestation. DEC-0149 calls staged advisory, meaning it should run beside the normal set, not instead of it. Either run the three-reviewer set alongside staged while advisory, or fall back to three when the verifier cannot credit staged; update docs/operations/reviewer-set-flag.md.
